title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 30
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 30: the words of Agur, two requests to God, the leech's daughters, and the small creatures that are exceedingly wise.

questions.text: Whose words does this chapter contain, according to the first verse?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens with the words of Agur the son of Jakeh, the revelation the man speaks to Ithiel and Ucal.

answers.text: The words of king Lemuel's mother
The words of Ithiel the son of Ucal
The words of the Preacher in Jerusalem
The words of Agur the son of Jakeh

questions.text: What does this chapter say about every word of God?
questions.explanation: The verse says every word of God is flawless, and that he is a shield to those who take refuge in him.

answers.text: It is hidden
It is flawless
It is heavy
It is sweet

questions.text: What two things does the speaker ask of God before he dies?
questions.explanation: He asks that falsehood and lies be removed far from him, and that he be given neither poverty nor riches, but the food that is needful for him.

answers.text: To remove lies, and to give neither poverty nor riches
Long life for himself and many children
Great wisdom and the knowledge of kings
A strong shield and a house that endures

questions.text: Why does the speaker not want to be full and rich?
questions.explanation: He says: lest I be full, deny you, and say, 'Who is Yahweh?'

answers.text: Lest he forget to feed the poor
Lest thieves break into his house
Lest he deny God and say, 'Who is Yahweh?'
Lest his sons quarrel over his wealth

questions.text: What do the leech's two daughters say?
questions.explanation: The verse says the leech has two daughters: 'Give, give.'

answers.text: "More, more"
"Give, give"
"Enough, enough"
"Feed us, feed us"

questions.text: What will happen to the eye that mocks at his father and scorns obedience to his mother?
questions.explanation: The verse says the ravens of the valley shall pick it out, and the young eagles shall eat it.

answers.text: It will grow dim with old age
It will never again see the light of the sun
It will weep bitter tears all its days
The ravens of the valley shall pick it out

questions.text: Which of these is among the things the speaker calls too amazing for him?
questions.explanation: The four things are the way of an eagle in the air, the way of a serpent on a rock, the way of a ship in the middle of the sea, and the way of a man with a maiden.

answers.text: The way of an eagle in the air
The way of a lion in the forest
The way of a fish in the deep
The way of a star in the night

questions.text: What do the ants, though not a strong people, do in the summer?
questions.explanation: The verse says the ants are not a strong people, yet they provide their food in the summer.

answers.text: They sleep in the rocks
They advance in ranks
They provide their food
They build in kings' palaces

questions.text: Which small creature can be caught with the hands, yet is in kings' palaces?
questions.explanation: The verse says you can catch a lizard with your hands, yet it is in kings' palaces.

answers.text: The lizard
The locust
The hyrax
The ant

questions.text: According to the last verse, what does the forcing of wrath produce?
questions.explanation: The verse says that as the churning of milk produces butter and the wringing of the nose produces blood, so the forcing of wrath produces strife.

answers.text: Fear
Blood
Peace
Strife
